integrity: Analytic proof with exact-rational return/Jacobian tests and isolating sign certificates; no independent mathematical audit or external certification has been conducted.
limitations: Only primitive period-two orbits of the explicitly specified real-plane family and strict exponential stability are classified. Higher periods, basins, and nonlinear critical-boundary attraction are not classified. A relevant 2022 comparative chapter was not accessible in full.
title: Two disjoint attracting two-cycle bands in a fixed-point-free quadratic map
